lines: Even so, from will-manifoldness, concealed — by self or by descent he joins, dead or through kinsman-grace's mouth:
duty-share committed in own self to the Supreme-Lord just — so the self, unmaimed, should see.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi icchāvaicitryāt tirobhūto 'pi svayaṃ vā śaktipātena yujyate mṛto vā bandhugurvādikṛpāmukhena ity evaṃ kṛtyabhāgitvaṃ svātmani anusaṃdadhat parameśvara eva iti na khaṇḍitam ātmānaṃ paśyet

reads_against.argmap: How does tirobhūta still connect? → Tirobhūta too is yujyate: svayaṃ or śaktipātena, mṛtaḥ or bandhu-guru-kṛpā-mukhena — kṛtya-bhāgitva committed to parameśvara eva; na khaṇḍitam ātmānaṃ paśyet.
c1_essence: Tirobhūta too is joined — svayaṃ or śaktipātena, dead or grace-mouthed: duty-share committed to the Supreme-Lord; the self seen unmaimed.
